% Regression: hard05_v4 — renders (O_L(M))_{(l_1..l_L),(r_1..r_L)}.
% T05 v4 — RMP arXiv:2011.12127, Fig:MPDO-O_L, in the PAPER's own
% orientation: the MPO O_L(M) generated by the MPDO tensor M "by
% contracting the same tensors VERTICALLY on a ring of length L".
% v2's gap (grid was horizontal-only; the figure had to be rendered
% rotated) is CLOSED by frame=vertical.
%
% Formula:  (O_L(M))_{(l_1..l_L),(r_1..r_L)}
%             = Tr[ M(l_1,r_1) M(l_2,r_2) ... M(l_L,r_L) ],
% where M(l,r) is M read as a matrix on its physical index pair, the
% trace runs over the chain of physical indices (the ring closure), and
% the virtual indices (l_j, r_j) of each site stay open — they are the
% physical legs of the MPO O_L.
%
% Declarative reading (first picture — compare ref_OL_hi-1.png):
%   frame=vertical — the whole grammar rotates 90 degrees: the
%     word descends the page, chain bonds run vertically, each op
%     site's leg pair points west/east (the l_j, r_j of the formula),
%     and \tndots renders \vdots.
%   periodic — the trace over the ring index.  In the vertical frame
%     the closure style DEFAULTS to hooks (the paper's edge-on ring:
%     a half-hook over the top box and under the bottom box, return
%     wire implied) — no style key is spelled.
%   tensor style=box — the reference draws M as a box with the label
%     inscribed.
% Second picture: periodic, trace style=racetrack OVERRIDES the vertical
% default with the explicit return wire down the page's side — the
% contrast shows the hooks default doing its width-saving work.
\documentclass[varwidth=19cm, border=6pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}
\usepackage{tenkz}
\begin{document}
\[
  O_L(M) \;=\;
  \begin{tenkz}[frame=vertical, physical=updown, periodic,
                tensor style=box]
    \tn{M} & \tndots & \tn{M}
  \end{tenkz}
\]

racetrack override, for contrast:
\[
  O_L(M) \;=\;
  \begin{tenkz}[frame=vertical, physical=updown,
                periodic, trace style=racetrack, tensor style=box]
    \tn{M} & \tndots & \tn{M}
  \end{tenkz}
\]
\end{document}
